resources.string: The chip is detected automatically. Select the GPU driver manually below. Updating the app keeps your current choice.
This driver library requires Android API %1$d or newer. It is listed for your chip, but cannot be loaded on this Android version.
Unisoc T820: choose System driver, MaliSX2 or Unified P48r1 below. Other T820 devices and firmware need their own game tests. Start at 1× and fully restart the app and game after changing drivers.

Dimensity 8300 / 8300 Ultra: choose a driver below. Unified P48r1 uses the same library as the RG477M package. Tests on RG477M do not establish compatibility with every device or firmware. Start at 1× and fully restart the app and game after changing drivers.

Unisoc T618: choose System driver or experimental Unified P48r1. Unified has not been tested on a physical T618. System driver remains the default. Fully restart the app and game after changing drivers.
